title: AARO resolution of Aguadilla video

tellings.quote: No, they did. They did. Aguadilla, which is uh which is one that existed before that.

plain: AARO, the Pentagon office that now investigates UFO reports, explained the Aguadilla video, a 2013 heat-camera recording of an object over the airport at Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, according to the UFO skeptic and researcher Mick West. West says this in a debate with Michels, insisting "they did" resolve it and that the case existed before the office's other work. He raises it to show that famous UFO videos have been given ordinary explanations.
